description: SHOW THE BIRTH CHART. Use when the person wants to see their chart, planet positions, Navamsa, Dasamsa (D10) or another divisional chart, or running dasha. Pass varga (for example D10) to open on that divisional chart. Returns a compact readable summary (Lagna, planet table, current Vimshottari, birth Panchanga, Navamsa) and, in hosts that support MCP Apps, an interactive South Indian Rasi/Navamsa chart with a dasha timeline. For interpretation of a question use consult_jyotishya instead. Calculates a complete South Indian chart from a known catalogue place or explicit latitude, longitude, and IANA timezone supplied by the MCP host. Bare place names auto-resolve to the curated best-effort match with alternatives noted. This deterministic tool never invokes another AI model.

varga.description: Divisional chart to open on, for example D10 (Dasamsa, career) or D7 (Saptamsa, children). Every divisional chart is in the result either way.
